property_summary: For every admissible call to transfer (sent by the required sender, with non-empty arrays and amounts that pass the overflow check), the reference C.transfer(...) returns true; the mutant returns false for calls that complete, so there exists inputs where the return value differs (mutant returns false) and thus violates the rule.
change_summary: Change the final returned boolean from true to false so transfer returns false instead of true when it completes.
